purpose: Public-safe semantic-review routing index. It excludes source prose and makes no append, novelty, openness, or recategorization claim.

selection_policy.append_authorization: Always false; even appendable_no_strong_match is only a source-recovery routing state.
selection_policy.direct: Only source-declared workspace_special_case or workspace_stronger_formulation routes.
selection_policy.non_direct: All non-direct rows whose crosswalk decision is not same_problem_reviewed.
selection_policy.public_boundary: Only IDs, hashes, source routes, candidate locators, and comparison metrics are retained.
